draft.subject: Research Engineer, Embodied AI @ Ant Group — Hoping for an Introduction
draft.body:
I’m Justin Mascarenhas, an M.S. Computer Engineering candidate at Rochester Institute of Technology (May 2026). I recently applied for the Research Engineer, Embodied AI role at Ant Group’s Sunnyvale office and wanted to reach out in hopes you might be willing to pass my name along to the right person on the engineering team.

My background is in robotics and real-robot deployment: for my MS capstone, I built an end-to-end embodied AI system — voice command → real-time visual perception at 18 FPS → physical robot arm completing pick-and-place tasks with 100% reliability across 10 trials. I’ve also executed manipulation trajectories on a physical UR5e in ROS2 and built sim-to-real training pipelines in CARLA. The research direction Ant Group is pursuing — transitioning intelligent agents into the physical world — is exactly where I want to build my career.

I recognize your work sits in a different part of the organization, and I appreciate you taking a moment to read this. If you’d be willing to forward this note or share a contact on the robotics or recruiting side, it would make a real difference for a new grad in a competitive search.

Resume attached. Happy to share more if useful.
